title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Report/source agree on conservative nondimensional Euler/NS formulation.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: cgns_reader.cpp:123,293–337 handles multiple zones and TRI_3/QUAD_4/BAR_2 sections; mixed triangles and quads in separate sections are supported. CGNS MIXED element sections fall through to an error.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: residual.cpp:163–251 assembles each face flux with opposite signs on owned adjacent cells, including inviscid and viscous terms.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: HLLC production flux plus Roe/Rusanov alternatives are implemented.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Characteristic farfield, slip, and no-slip wall paths inspected.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: gradients.cpp:9–29,103 and residual.cpp:83–108 implement least-squares gradients and limited face states; report.tex:395–410,454–517 documents first-order cells and limiter freezing.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Venkat/Barth and positivity exist; production freeze/fallback is documented.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: viscous_flux.cpp:41–57 removes normal traction; forces.cpp:69–74,100–113 integrates tangential shear; boundary-condition values are written to surface rows at forces.cpp:173–179.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: CFL local pseudo-time and LU-SGS are implemented.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Selected raw Re200 force history reaches t=300; metadata reports 169/30000 target misses (99.44% success). Final source implements BDF2 and explicit residual-ratio checks, but its exact identity with the executed binary is unproven because the configured revision stamp conflicts with the selected launch option.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: partition.cpp:52–73 invokes METIS; halo_exchange.cpp:36–55 and communicator.cpp:82,112–159 provide neighbor exchanges/reductions. Report rank tables compare np2/4/8; timing is unsuitable to establish scaling.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
